_meta.purpose: Reference catalog mapping CWE identifiers to name/description/OWASP category. ENRICHMENT ONLY: scanners that already emit a 'cwe' string may attach this metadata to a finding they ALREADY produced. This file NEVER creates a finding, NEVER assigns a CWE, and NEVER changes severity.
_meta.source: MITRE CWE list + OWASP Top 10 2021 category mapping

CWE-22.name: Path Traversal
CWE-22.description: Improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory ('../') lets an attacker read or write files outside the intended directory.

CWE-77.name: Command Injection
CWE-77.description: Construction of a command using externally-influenced input without neutralization, allowing an attacker to alter the intended command.

CWE-78.name: OS Command Injection
CWE-78.description: Improper neutralization of special elements in an OS command, allowing arbitrary command execution on the host.

CWE-79.name: Cross-site Scripting (XSS)
CWE-79.description: Improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing script to execute in a victim's browser.

CWE-89.name: SQL Injection
CWE-89.description: Improper neutralization of special elements in an SQL command, allowing modification of query logic.

CWE-90.name: LDAP Injection
CWE-90.description: Improper neutralization of special elements in an LDAP query, allowing modification of directory queries.

CWE-91.name: XML Injection
CWE-91.description: Improper neutralization of special elements in XML, allowing alteration of XML structure or queries (XPath/XQuery).

CWE-94.name: Code Injection
CWE-94.description: Improper control of generation of code, allowing an attacker to inject code that is then executed (e.g. SSTI, eval).

CWE-113.name: HTTP Response Splitting
CWE-113.description: Improper neutralization of CRLF sequences in HTTP headers, enabling header injection and response splitting.

CWE-200.name: Information Exposure
CWE-200.description: Exposure of sensitive information to an actor not explicitly authorized to have access to it.

CWE-209.name: Information Exposure Through Error Message
CWE-209.description: Generation of an error message that includes sensitive information about the environment or internals.

CWE-256.name: Plaintext Storage of a Password
CWE-256.description: Storing passwords in a recoverable (plaintext or weakly-protected) format.

CWE-285.name: Improper Authorization
CWE-285.description: The software does not perform or incorrectly performs an authorization check when an actor attempts to access a resource.

CWE-287.name: Improper Authentication
CWE-287.description: When an actor claims to have a given identity, the software does not prove or insufficiently proves that the claim is correct.

CWE-295.name: Improper Certificate Validation
CWE-295.description: The software does not validate, or incorrectly validates, a certificate, enabling impersonation or MITM.

CWE-306.name: Missing Authentication for Critical Function
CWE-306.description: The software does not perform any authentication for functionality that requires a provable user identity.

CWE-311.name: Missing Encryption of Sensitive Data
CWE-311.description: The software does not encrypt sensitive data before storage or transmission.

CWE-312.name: Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information
CWE-312.description: The application stores sensitive information in cleartext within a resource accessible to an attacker.

CWE-319.name: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information
CWE-319.description: The software transmits sensitive data in cleartext over a channel that can be sniffed (e.g. plain HTTP, Telnet, FTP).

CWE-326.name: Inadequate Encryption Strength
CWE-326.description: The software stores or transmits sensitive data using an encryption scheme that is too weak for the level of protection required.

CWE-327.name: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
CWE-327.description: The use of a broken or risky cryptographic algorithm (e.g. MD5, SHA-1, DES, RC4, SSLv3) leaving data exposed.

CWE-352.name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
CWE-352.description: The web application does not verify that a request was intentionally provided by the user who submitted it.

CWE-359.name: Exposure of Private Personal Information
CWE-359.description: The product exposes private personal information to an actor not authorized to access it.

CWE-384.name: Session Fixation
CWE-384.description: Authenticating a user without invalidating an existing session identifier, allowing an attacker to steal a validated session.

CWE-400.name: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
CWE-400.description: The software does not properly control the allocation and maintenance of a limited resource, enabling denial of service.

CWE-434.name: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
CWE-434.description: The software allows upload of files of a type that can be automatically processed within the product's environment.

CWE-444.name: HTTP Request Smuggling
CWE-444.description: Inconsistencies in how front-end and back-end servers interpret HTTP requests allow request smuggling.

CWE-502.name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
CWE-502.description: The application deserializes untrusted data without sufficient verification, enabling object injection / RCE.
CWE-502.owasp_category: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures

CWE-521.name: Weak Password Requirements
CWE-521.description: The product does not require that users have strong passwords, making accounts easier to compromise.

CWE-522.name: Insufficiently Protected Credentials
CWE-522.description: The product transmits or stores authentication credentials using an insecure method susceptible to interception.

CWE-601.name: Open Redirect
CWE-601.description: A web application accepts user-controlled input that specifies a link to an external site used in a redirect.

CWE-611.name: XML External Entity (XXE)
CWE-611.description: The software processes XML with external entity references enabled, allowing file disclosure / SSRF.

CWE-639.name: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key (IDOR)
CWE-639.description: The system's authorization functionality does not prevent one user from accessing another user's data by manipulating a key.

CWE-732.name: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource
CWE-732.description: The product assigns permissions to a security-critical resource in a way that allows unintended access.

CWE-776.name: XML Entity Expansion (Billion Laughs)
CWE-776.description: The software allows nested entity expansion in XML, enabling a denial-of-service amplification attack.

CWE-798.name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
CWE-798.description: The product contains hard-coded credentials such as a password or cryptographic key for inbound/outbound communication.

CWE-862.name: Missing Authorization
CWE-862.description: The software does not perform an authorization check when an actor attempts to access a resource or perform an action.

CWE-863.name: Incorrect Authorization
CWE-863.description: The software performs an authorization check but does so incorrectly, granting access that should be denied.

CWE-915.name: Mass Assignment
CWE-915.description: The software does not properly control modification of dynamically-determined object attributes, allowing privilege fields to be set.
CWE-915.owasp_category: A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures

CWE-918.name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
CWE-918.description: The web server receives a URL from an upstream component and retrieves its contents without validating the destination.

CWE-942.name: Permissive Cross-domain Policy (CORS)
CWE-942.description: The software uses a cross-domain policy that includes domains that should not be trusted, exposing data cross-origin.

CWE-1004.name: Sensitive Cookie Without HttpOnly Flag
CWE-1004.description: A cookie holding sensitive data is set without the HttpOnly attribute, exposing it to client-side script.

CWE-1021.name: Improper Restriction of Rendered UI Layers (Clickjacking)
CWE-1021.description: The web page can be framed by another site, enabling UI-redress (clickjacking) attacks.

CWE-1275.name: Sensitive Cookie with Improper SameSite Attribute
CWE-1275.description: A sensitive cookie is set without a restrictive SameSite attribute, increasing CSRF exposure.

CWE-1395.name: Dependency on Vulnerable Third-Party Component
CWE-1395.description: The product uses a vulnerable third-party component with one or more known weaknesses (version-based / SCA finding).
